ig_caption:
Sat, Nov 14: 2,545 deer reported statewide (1,877 antlered, 668 antlerless). Season total: 102,647.

Saturday's 2,545 new reports were the most since Nov 9, and 74% were antlered, down from 78% the day before. Alcona ran the most antlerless of any county with 25 or more new reports (49% of 41), while Barry was 90% antlered.
